description: Department of Local Govt. - Central Province - Notify the Names of Mayors & Chairmen for the Local Authorities in Kandy, Matale and Nuwara-Eliya Districts.
categorisation: This gazette contains a notice under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring the names of elected officials (Mayors, Deputy Mayors, Chairmen, and Vice Chairmen) for various local government institutions. The content is specifically related to the results and declarations of local government elections, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7).
